formulas.formula: sin(α+β) = sin αcos β + cos αsin β
sin(α-β) = sin αcos β - cos αsin β
tan(α+β) = (tan α + tan β)/(1 - tan αtan β)
tan(α-β) = (tan α - tan β)/(1 + tan αtan β)

raw_head:
1. sin(α+β) = sin αcos β + cos αsin β
2. sin(α-β) = sin αcos β - cos αsin β
3. tan(α+β) = (tan α + tan β)/(1 - tan αtan β)
4. tan(α-β) = (tan α - tan β)/(1 + tan αtan β)
5. sin α = -3/5
6. cos α = √(1 - sin²α) = √(1 - (-3/5)²) = 4/5
7. tan α = sin α/cos α = (-3/5)/(4/5) = -3/4
8. sin(π/4 - α) = sin
